target_scope: all expected pre-rank stages + COMPOSE + every observed post-rank stage

metric_definitions.logical_calls: one per LLM call INTENT the run spends: retries of one intent and provider fallbacks within one intent group into a single logical call (deterministic sequential rule over the ordered ledger lines of a stage+task key; chains with an unrecorded head are one call, flagged)
metric_definitions.provider_attempts: one per provider REQUEST: retries, transport failures and provider fallbacks each count — quota cost, NOT the design budget

target_statement: the twelve-call target is the pipeline's DESIGN call budget and applies to the LOGICAL-CALLS measure only; provider attempts (429-storm retries, fallbacks) are reported separately under total_provider_attempts and are never certified against the target
note: P0-6 canonical ledger: logical_calls and provider_attempts are SEPARATE measures. The target certifies the LOGICAL measure only; a NOT_MEASURED expected stage blocks its measure's total (a partial measurement must not certify compliance); observed post-rank stages (the engine's POST_RANK_* / IMPROVE ledger stages) are included in the totals
